info.name: MulaPay Core API
info.description:
Full API collection for MulaPay Core API.

**Surfaces**
- `v1/` — Public merchant API (API key auth)
- `dashboard/v1/` — Merchant dashboard (JWT session)
- `admin/v1/` — Admin console (staff JWT, MFA required)

**Variables** — set these in your Postman environment:
- `baseUrl` — e.g. `https://api.mulapay.com` or `http://localhost:3000`
- `accessToken` — dashboard or admin JWT access token
- `apiKey` — live or test API key for the public API
